resources.string: Eliminate those who stand in your path.
Kill players by using your dope abilities!\%nl\%Preferably, explode \%b\%only\%/b\% in a secluded area.
The Sentinel is a Neutral Killing role that can explode themselves to kill anyone nearby. They may also kill normally, but where's the fun in that?
Gulp down every last one of them.
Use your Gulp ability to swallow players whole!\%nl\%Swallowed players vanish with \%b\%no body\%/b\% left behind. They die for good when a meeting is called.

The Abyss is a Neutral Killing role that swallows other players, hiding them from the game entirely. Swallowed players leave no corpse and do not appear in the meeting dead list â€” until the next meeting is called, at which point they die for good. If the Abyss dies, any swallowed players are released alive.
Swallow a nearby player. They vanish from the map and are hidden until the next meeting.
Use your Erase ability to mark players.\%nl\%Their role will be wiped at the \%b\%next meeting\%/b\%, no matter what happens in between.

The Eraser is an Impostor role that can target players and erase their roles. Erased players lose their role at the start of the next meeting â€” the erase is permanent and cannot be undone, even if the Eraser dies before the meeting. Each erase increases the Erase cooldown. By default, the Eraser cannot erase other Impostors. If a Neutral player is erased, the host can configure whether they become a Crewmate or die outright.
Mark a player for erasure. Their role will be removed at the start of the next meeting.
Take someone's place before they even know it.

Use your Shift ability to target a player.\%nl\%At the \%b\%end of the next meeting\%/b\%, you'll swap roles with them â€” they become the Shifter, and you become whatever they were.\%nl\%The swap happens \%b\%even if either of you is dead\%/b\% before the meeting ends.

The Shifter is a Neutral Benign role that can swap roles with another player. The target must be chosen during the round, and the swap always occurs at the end of the next meeting â€” the target will not know until after the meeting who shifted with them. The shift is guaranteed even if the Shifter or the target dies before the meeting ends. The player who was shifted becomes the Shifter in their place.
Target a player to swap roles with. The swap takes effect at the end of the next meeting, no matter what.
Your word is law. Enforce it.

As the Dictator you hold ultimate authority in meetings.\%nl\%Use \%b\%End Meeting\%/b\% to instantly dismiss a meeting with no exile.\%nl\%Use \%b\%Condemn\%/b\% to force all votes onto a chosen player, ensuring their exile.\%nl\%Each use costs one of your limited charges.

The Dictator is a Crewmate Power role with limited uses. During a meeting they have two special buttons: End Meeting, which immediately closes the meeting with no exile, and Condemn, which forces 15 votes onto any chosen player guaranteeing their removal. Depending on settings, the Dictator may sacrifice themselves after using Condemn, or once their uses are exhausted.
Instantly end the meeting with no exile. Costs one use.
Click Condemn, then click a player to force all votes onto them. They will be exiled. Costs one use.
Dictator Sacrifices When Uses Run Out
Choose a player and drag them to their death.

Use Distort to open a player menu and choose your target. The target is pulled toward you while still visible, then automatically killed once they reach you. After the kill, you become invisible for a set duration and then return visible.

The Distorter is an Impostor Concealing role that selects targets through a player menu. Distort visibly drags the chosen target toward the Distorter, then executes them automatically on arrival. The Distorter then enters temporary invisibility with bonus speed, cannot kill during that invisibility, and a HUD countdown shows how long invisibility remains.
Mark a nearby player. After wind-up, pull them to you, enter phase, then gain brief invisibility and speed.
